messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: routing-service — elevated 5xx and model-variant mismatches observed across EU regions. Paging @morgan (primary oncall) and @raj (eng-runtime).

morgan: seeing a spike in errors from the smart-router in eu-west1 and eu-central. Thousands of requests falling back repeatedly to a small-quant variant that's failing tokenization. Error sample: "model_variant_mismatch: tokenizer_incompatible".

raj: on it. Any recent policy/schema changes?

lexi: I deployed the new routing schema this morning (remove deprecated field `preferred_model` -> replaced by `policy.precedence`). Did a quick dry-run and tests passed.

samir: fwiw, monitoring shows fallback loops: requests try region primary -> fail -> fallback to another region -> router thinks fallback variant incompatible and re-fails, loops until TTL kicks in. Latency and error amplification.

morgan: customers impacted: a few mid-market accounts in EU are reporting high error rates for 'chat' endpoints. CS ticket inbound. Prioritize mitigation.

raj: quick mitigation ideas: 1) disable cross-region fallback for EU 2) force-route traffic to last known-good variant 3) roll back schema. Which is safest?

emily: option 1 is fastest. We can flip `allow_cross_region_fallback=false` via the feature-flagger in console. That should stop oscillation immediately.

morgan: do it. I will start customer-facing comms. @lexi can you confirm no DB migrations would be affected?

lexi: feature-flag only, no migration. Pushing change now.

oncall-bot: Deploy started by lexi (routing-config) — change: set allow_cross_region_fallback=false for eu-* policies.

lexi: done. Console shows flag updated across control plane.

raj: I'm patching the router to short-circuit fallbacks to the failing variant: adding a guard to avoid selecting variants with tokenizer mismatch metadata. Patch in canary now.

samir: putting a temporary rate-limit on the affected model variants as well to reduce downstream retries.

morgan: CS update: opened incident banner for affected customers, initial ETA unknown. Ticket numbers: CS-2456.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy succeeded (10% routers) — no further tokenization errors in canary.

raj: rolling to 50% now.

lexi: quick check: the root cause appears to be that the schema migration removed `preferred_model` but the server-side mapper treats absence as 'choose default' which resolves to a newly promoted quantized variant (`small-quant-v2`). That variant was never fully tested with the tokenizer bundle in eu regions. So absence -> wrong default -> incompatibility.

emily: ouch. So the deprecated field removal changed defaulting behavior. Need a postmortem later on schema backward compatibility.

morgan: for immediate mitigation I want two things: 1) a rollback to previous schema defaults or explicit mapping to last-known-good variant 2) escalate to product & QA.

lexi: rolling the schema back to include explicit `preferred_model: chat-large-v1` in the policy store for the affected customers now. This will take ~2 minutes to propagate.

oncall-bot: Rollback ticket opened by lexi (routing-config-rollback).

raj: routing canary at 100% — no more tokenizer errors observed in eu-west1 for the last 10m. Good signal.

samir: lowering rate-limits on the `small-quant-v2` variant to 0 in eu regions to avoid any ambiguous routing while we investigate.

morgan: ok I'm going to hand off to @raj for post-fix monitoring. Next oncall (emily) I'll handover in 20m with notes.

emily: acknowledged — I'll take over the watch and coordinate postmortem. Please include the mapping rule that caused defaulting in the incident notes.

morgan: customer impact summary: 3 customers experienced >30% error rate in EU for 8–12 minutes. No data loss. Affected endpoints: /v1/chat, /v1/complete. CS has notified customers and offered rollback to prior model.

raj: root-cause hypothesis: schema migration removed a deprecated field; runtime defaulting behaviour interprets absent field as 'auto-select' which picked an unvetted variant. Fixes: add validation in schema migration, enforce explicit default fallback mapping, and add an integration test verifying tokenizer compatibility for promoted variants.

lexi: filed follow-ups: ENG-1242 (schema-compat test), ENG-1243 (validate migration defaults), ENG-1244 (policy audit tool).

morgan: handoff: next oncall @emily. Key actions: keep cross-region fallback disabled for EU until we validate promoted variants; monitor 5xx rate and model-mismatch alerts; coordinate with product for the postmortem.

emily: taking over. I'll update the incident doc and schedule a follow-up meeting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged by emily. Incident channel: #inc-1965432100.
